critical_code_review_comments: Quotes.js customerFilter lazy init (line 57) only reads URL param on mount — if user navigates to /quotes?customer_id=X while already on /quotes (e.g., via in-app link), the filter won't update. Low risk for current flow (navigation from /customers always re-mounts the component), but worth noting.

PendingCustomerActionsWidget: no RETRY dispatch type — the widget has LOADING/LOADED/ERROR states and a load() callback called on retry click, but the reducer has no explicit RETRY case (load() calls dispatch(LOADING) first, so it works correctly via the LOADING case). Non-issue.
